Kerti faszenes grill, nyugágyak, két füg: Garden charcoal grill, sun loungers, two hanging chairs, free electric scooters and electric car charging.
Ha kiszakadnátok a nyugalomból, Szada kö: If you want to step out of the calm for a day, there is plenty to do around Szada: an arboretum, a royal palace, a bear sanctuary, an equestrian park and a basilica. All are within 30 minutes of the house by car.
Magyarország legnagyobb botanikus kertje: Hungary's largest botanical garden, with more than a century and a half of history.
A Vácrátóti Arborétum az ország legnagyo: The Vácrátót Arboretum is the country's largest botanical garden and has been running for more than a century and a half. Across its spacious, well-kept grounds, themed gardens, exotic and native plant collections, shady tree-lined avenues and picturesque lakes follow one another.
Minden évszakban más arcát mutatja: tava: It shows a different face in every season: flowering bulbs and shrubs in spring, lush greenery and reflecting lakes in summer, golden foliage in autumn. You can stroll comfortably along wide, well-kept paths, and the greenhouses hold plants from all over the world.
Pároknak, családoknak és egyedül érkezők: A good choice for couples, families and solo visitors alike. It is excellent for quiet walks and photography, especially in autumn.
Menedék és oktatóközpont megmentett barn: A shelter and education centre for rescued brown bears and wolves.
A veresegyházi Medveotthon menedékként é: The Medveotthon in Veresegyház works as a shelter and an education centre. Rescued brown bears and wolves live here in a spacious, natural habitat, in calm, stress-free surroundings, and visitors can watch them from a respectful distance.
A legnépszerűbb élmény a medvék etetése:: The most popular experience is feeding the bears: with a long wooden spoon you can offer them honey. It is especially memorable for children, but adults also get a fascinating insight into the bears' behaviour and natural habits.
Kényelmes sétautak és információs táblák: Comfortable footpaths and information boards help you find your way. It is an ideal family outing, mostly from spring to autumn, when the animals are more active. The visit also draws attention to the importance of animal welfare and responsible nature conservation.
Lovas bemutatók, fogathajtás és hagyomán: Riding shows, carriage driving and traditional Hungarian food among rolling hills.
Domonyvölgy lankás dombjai, zöld mezői é: Lázár Equestrian Park lies among the rolling hills, green meadows and quiet countryside of Domonyvölgy. Here you can get to know Hungarian horse culture and rural traditions up close.
A park látványos lovas bemutatóiról isme: The park is known for its spectacular riding shows, where skilled riders present elements of traditional Hungarian riding and carriage driving. The programmes are often accompanied by live commentary, so you understand the significance of these centuries-old traditions even better.
A területen hagyományos magyar ételeket: On site there are restaurants serving traditional Hungarian dishes, a petting zoo you can walk through, and carriage rides. A good programme for families, groups and international guests, if you fancy a slower day close to nature.
Csendes erdei park akadálymentes sétányo: A quiet forest park with accessible paths, also good for dog walking and picnics.
A Gödöllői Arborétum, közismert nevén az: The Gödöllő Arboretum, known locally as Arbo-Park, is a quiet forest park close to nature. The well-kept, spacious grounds show a variety of forest types and many tree species, yet keep the calm of the natural setting. Come here if you want to get a little away from the bustle of the city.
A jól karbantartott, akadálymentes sétán: On the well-kept, accessible paths, people of all ages can walk comfortably. It suits a family outing, dog walking or a quiet walk for two. Each season gives something different: fresh green leaves in spring and colourful foliage in autumn make the visit memorable.
Könnyen bejárható, mégis elég tágas ahho: Easy to walk, yet spacious enough to quieten down in. A good place for a picnic, light exercise or simply a slow walk in nature.
Barokk kastély Gödöllőn, Erzsébet király: A baroque palace in Gödöllő, favourite summer residence of Queen Elisabeth (Sisi).
A gödöllői Grassalkovich-kastély Magyaro: The Grassalkovich Palace in Gödöllő is one of Hungary's most important baroque monuments. It is especially well known because Queen Elisabeth, known as Sisi, used it as her favourite summer residence, and it also played an important role in the days of the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy.
A pompásan berendezett termekben eredeti: In the splendidly furnished rooms, original furniture, works of art and historical exhibitions evoke everyday life at court. It is worth choosing a guided tour: it tells you in detail about the history of the palace, its residents and the political background of the era.
A látogatás után a kastélyt körülvevő pa: After your visit you can walk calmly in the park and ornamental gardens around the palace. An elegant, rewarding cultural programme for anyone interested in history, architecture and royal life.
1050 méteres aszfaltozott gokartpálya, 1: A 1,050-metre asphalt go-kart track with more than 15 karts.
A Szada Ring modern gokartpálya Szadán,: Szada Ring is a modern go-kart track in Szada, on the far side of the village, so it is about 25 minutes from the house by car. The technical, 1,050-metre asphalt track is 8–10 metres wide, and the karts can reach speeds of up to 70 km/h in a safe environment.
A különböző teljesítményű gokartoknak kö: Karts of different power mean beginners and more experienced drivers both have a good time. It is a good programme for groups of friends, families and corporate team-building alike: experienced staff help, races come with professional timing, and the vehicles are regularly maintained.
A helyszínen mini KRESZ-park a legkisebb: On site there is also a mini traffic park for the little ones and a bicycle pump track. For opening hours and booking, check the track's website.
1755-ben épült, ma is népszerű zarándokh: Built in 1755, still a popular place of pilgrimage in Máriabesnyő.
A Máriabesnyői Nagyboldogasszony-bazilik: The Máriabesnyő Basilica of the Assumption is one of Hungary's most important pilgrimage sites and has drawn visitors for more than two and a half centuries. The church, built in 1755, defines the skyline of the area from afar.
A belső teret gazdagon díszített oltárok: The interior is marked by richly decorated altars, finely detailed frescoes and harmonious proportions. The quiet of the church invites reflection, whether religious or cultural interest brought you here.
Különösen szép a késő délutáni órákban,: It is especially beautiful in the late afternoon, when the setting sun lights up the façade. A good short outing if you want calm and inner recharge.
Három jelzett túra a Gödöllői-dombságban: Three marked hikes in the Gödöllő Hills: Margita tower, the Máriabesnyő loop, the Szada loop.
Margita és a szent koronás mérőtorony: Margita and the survey tower with the Holy Crown
háztól autóval kb. 5 perc: approx. 5 min by car from the house
Rövid erdei túra Szada legmagasabb pontj: A short forest hike to Szada's highest point. On top of the 344.2-metre Margita stands a 30-metre geodetic survey tower built in 1974, with a stylised replica of the Holy Crown added in 2006. The marked path starts at the end of Arany János utca, at the edge of the village; at the junctions, the yellow stripe and red triangle markings lead to the tower.
A tetőről a Visegrádi-hegység, a Börzsön: From the top you can see the Visegrád Mountains, the Börzsöny, the Cserhát and the Mátra. Climbing the tower's inner ladders is dangerous, as a sign at the entrance says, so do it only at your own risk.
Máriabesnyő, Pap Miska-kút és a babati t: Máriabesnyő, Pap Miska Spring and the Babat church ruin
háztól autóval kb. 15 perc: approx. 15 min by car from the house
A túra a máriabesnyői kegyhely székelyka: The hike starts at the Székely gate of the Máriabesnyő shrine, past the Stations of the Cross and the basilica. The red marking climbs Gudra Hill (the hardest section, 65 metres of ascent, about a quarter of an hour), then descends on a narrow path to the Pap Miska Spring. From there you cross under the M3 motorway to the Babat stable manor and the memorial plaque of the church ruin, and return to Máriabesnyő along the Mária út markings.
Az autópálya közelében a forgalom zaja e: Near the motorway, traffic noise accompanies you for a while. By car you can park in the car park next to the shrine. If you want something shorter: the walk to the Pap Miska Spring is 5.2 km, 150 m ascent, about 2 hours.
Jelzett kör Szadáról a Gödöllői-dombság: A marked loop from Szada through the forests of the Gödöllő Hills. The yellow cross marking leads out of the village, the yellow stripe takes you to Magyalos-tető, and from there the red stripe climbs to the top of Margita. On the way back you return to Szada on the familiar yellow stripe.
Egész napos programnál rövidebb, mégis t: Shorter than a full-day outing, yet a rewarding hike for fitter walkers and families alike. According to the description, until a lookout tower is built, only the geodetic tower stands among the trees at the summit.
Az adatok a hivatkozott túraleírásokból: The data come from the linked trail descriptions. Before you set out, check the current markings, the weather and the condition of the route.
Összegyűjtöttük a legtöbbet feltett kérd: We have collected the most frequently asked questions so that you know everything before booking. If you still cannot find the answer, we are happy to help.
Foglalhatunk csak egy éjszakára?: Can we book for just one night?
Igen. Nálunk nincs minimum tartózkodás,: Yes. There is no minimum stay; you can book even for a single night. The price is 60,000 HUF per night per apartment, also on weekends and public holidays.
Mennyibe kerül egy éjszaka?: How much does a night cost?
Egy apartman két főnek 60.000 Ft éjszaká: One apartment for two guests costs 60,000 HUF per night. The whole house for the two of you is 90,000 HUF per night, bookable by phone only. Two apartments together (3-4 guests) cost 2 × 60,000 HUF, that is 120,000 HUF per night. We have no weekend or holiday surcharge and no separate cleaning fee, and we do not charge tourist tax either.
Az oldalon a Szabad időpontok részben ki: In the Availability section of this page, choose your arrival, departure and number of guests, then the apartment. You can arrange booking the whole house by phone: +36 70 245 8403.
Foglaláskor a teljes összeget (100%) elő: At booking we ask you to pay the full amount (100%) in advance. Payment is online, by bank card, bank transfer, or with an OTP, MBH or K&H SZÉP card.
Hogyan tudjuk módosítani a foglalásunkat: How can we change our booking?
Tudjuk, hogy az élet néha felülírja a te: We know that life sometimes overrides our plans, so we try to handle booking changes as flexibly as we can. If you tell us you wish to change your booking by 10:00 at the latest on the day of arrival, we will rebook it once, within 6 months of the planned arrival date, at no extra charge.
Az érkezés napján 10:00 óra után sajnos: After 10:00 on the day of arrival we are unfortunately no longer able to accept changes. In that case, the amount paid is forfeited as a cancellation penalty.
Mikor lehet elfoglalni a szállást, és me: When can we check in, and when do we have to leave?
Az érkezés napján 15:00 órától várunk sz: We look forward to welcoming you from 15:00 on the day of arrival, and ask you to leave the apartment by 11:00 at the latest on the day of departure. Check-in and check-out are contactless by default, so that arriving and leaving are as convenient as possible. If you would like to hand over or receive the accommodation in person and let us know in advance, we will gladly meet you.
Hogyan kapjuk meg a kulcsot?: How do we get the key?
Ahhoz, hogy megkaphassátok az ingatlan e: To receive the code of the electronic key safe, located on the fence next to the small gate in front of the property, please upload the required personal data to the NTAK/VIZA system via the link we send before your arrival. Under the applicable laws, providing this data is mandatory for every guest. After the data has been recorded successfully, we send the key safe code by SMS on the day of arrival. In the key safe you will find the apartment keys and the remote control for the electric gate.
A kulcsok átvételét követően díjmentesen: Once you have the keys, you can use the car park in the enclosed courtyard free of charge; it is monitored by a security camera, and we provide one parking space per apartment.
Merre található a ház, és hogyan jutunk: Where is the house, and how do we get there?
Szadán a Dózsa György útról a legegyszer: In Szada, from Dózsa György út, the easiest way to reach Aranyhegy Guesthouse is via Buckai utca or Ősz utca. When you reach Aranyhegy utca, turn right on either route.
Felhívjuk a figyelmeteket, hogy a Google: Please note that Google Maps sometimes wrongly routes guests onto a forest track, so please follow the route above first.
Jelenleg reggeli bekészítését nem biztos: We do not currently provide breakfast, but we are continuously working on expanding our services. Just 3 minutes by car (1.5 km) away there is a Lidl supermarket where you can easily buy everything you need for breakfast. The apartment has a capsule coffee machine and a fully equipped kitchen at your disposal.
Hányan jöhetünk?: How many of us can come?
Apartmanházunk egy épületben két különál: Our guesthouse has two separate apartments in one building, each designed for the comfortable rest of 2 adults. Only the persons named in the booking may stay in the accommodation, and only they may use its services.
Mit találunk az apartmanban?: What will we find in the apartment?
Mindkét apartman 30 m²-es, egy légterű,: Both apartments are 30 m², open-plan, with their own terrace. A 160×200 cm double bed with a premium mattress, air conditioning for heating and cooling, underfloor heating, electric roller shutters, a fully equipped kitchen with a capsule coffee machine, a 55-inch smart TV (Netflix, Prime Video), unlimited free Wi-Fi, as well as entertainment and skill board games and self-discovery and relationship card games. In the shower room you will find quality toiletries, bathrobes, towels and hotel slippers, and a separate sheet is provided for the sauna.
Apartmanjaink felnőttbarát szálláshelyek: Our apartments are adults-only accommodation, so unfortunately we cannot accept guests under 18.
Nagy állatbarátok vagyunk, otthonunkban: We are great animal lovers, and dogs and cats live in our home, but unfortunately we cannot currently accept pets in the apartments. Smoking is not allowed either.
Tarthatunk-e születésnapi rendezvényt va: Can we hold a birthday party or a get-together with friends?
Nem. Apartmanházunk a nyugodt, csendes k: No. Our guesthouse is for guests seeking calm, quiet relaxation, so birthday parties, house parties, get-togethers with friends, bachelor and bachelorette parties and other events are not allowed. Thank you for respecting this rule and helping every guest rest undisturbed.
Apartmanházunk a Gödöllői-dombság lankás: Our guesthouse stands on the gently sloping terrain of the Gödöllő Hills, so unfortunately we could not provide a fully accessible design.
A wellness szolgáltatások kizárólagos ha: Is the wellness area for our exclusive use?
A jakuzzi és a szaunák közösek a másik a: The jacuzzi and the saunas are shared with the guests of the other apartment. Since there are never more than four guests in the house at once, using the shared areas is easy to coordinate. If both apartments have guests, we provide a 2-hour private evening wellness slot per couple on request, so your stargazing jacuzzi time is guaranteed to be yours alone. If you want to use it all day by yourselves, book the whole house (90,000 HUF / night, by phone), provided both apartments are free on those nights.
Mikor használhatjuk a jakuzzit és a szau: When can we use the jacuzzi and the saunas?
A fedett jakuzzi, a finn szauna és az in: The covered jacuzzi, the Finnish sauna and the infrared sauna can be used undisturbed all year round, even in bad weather. Use is free and unlimited, and guides placed on site help you with the use. A sauna sheet is provided for the sauna. Aromatherapy oils are also available.
Mikor használható a medence?: When can we use the pool?
A kültéri temperált medence szezonális:: The outdoor temperature-controlled pool is seasonal: it is open from spring to autumn. The jacuzzi and the sauna operate all year round.
Mit használhatunk a kertben?: What can we use in the garden?
A tágas, 2400 m²-es kertben napozóágyak,: The spacious 2,400 m² garden has sun loungers, a gazebo and a barbecue area. For the grill we set out charcoal and lighting supplies, and to explore the area we provide electric scooters free of charge. You will also find ideas about the area's sights on the information board in the apartment's entrance.
Tudunk elektromos autót tölteni a szállá: Can we charge an electric car at the property?
Igen, külön díjazás ellenében elektromos: Yes, for an extra fee we also offer electric car charging. Charging costs 3,500 HUF per session, up to 50 kWh of energy. One vehicle can be charged at a time, and the owner of the vehicle provides the necessary cable. The service fee must be paid before check-out by online bank card payment or bank transfer.

The voucher is valid for 12 months.
